definitions.explanation: A warm, reddish-brown color resembling polished copper. Used to describe skin tanned by the sun, metallic surfaces, or autumn foliage.

examples.japanese: {銅色|あかがねいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}けた→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧。
examples.english: Skin tanned to a copper color.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされて→照らす：04669_terasu⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{銅色|あかがねいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: Lit by the setting sun, the roof shone with a copper glow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{夏|なつ}の{終|お}わり→夏の終わり：26768_natsunoowari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銅色|あかがねいろ}になっていた。
examples.english: By the end of a summer spent at the beach, the children's skin had turned a bronze color.

notes: {銅|あかがね} is a classical Japanese word for copper (literally "red metal"), in contrast to the more common modern reading ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧. The compound {銅色|あかがねいろ} has a literary and evocative quality. It is often used to describe well-tanned skin ({銅色|あかがねいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧) and conveys a warm, healthy, outdoorsy image. The more colloquial equivalent would be {銅色|どういろ}, though あかがねいろ is preferred in literary or descriptive writing.
